newsitem.title: EGYPT: Jordan's PM to visit Cairo for talks on peace.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's PM to visit Cairo for talks on peace.

text.p: Jordanian Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti will visit Cairo on Wednesday for talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on the beleagured Middle East peace process, Egyptian officials said on Tuesday.

Jordan's King Hussein on Tuesday became the first Arab head of state to visit Palestinian-ruled areas. The king arrived in Jericho with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, his host, who had visited him in Amman.
Palestinian officials said the monarch was trying to arrange a meeting between the two of them and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
Egypt and Jordan are the only two Arab states who have signed peace treaties with Israel.
